notes.title: The Haunted: Hells Reach Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to The Haunted: Hells Reach have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

- Fixed problems with ladder animations getting out of synch
- Fixed problems with weapon and character lockup
- Added leaderboards for nightmare difficulty
- Fixed problems with re-hosting listen servers
- Fixed problems with client side achievements and leaderboards
- Added two new achievements
- Added difficulty and country information to the server browser
- Dedicated server now properly supports multiple instances under different ports
- Added bat files for dedicated servers to run multiple instances under different ports

notes.title: The Haunted: Hells Reach Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to The Haunted: Hells Reach have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

- Added two new difficulty levels: Beginner and Nightmare
- Added in-game hints
- Minor re-balancing of difficulty levels
- Added per level achievements
- Performance improvements on level content
- VOIP is no longer muted by default
- Fixed connection problems
- Dedicated server is now using HLDS
- Added controller button tool-tips

notes.title: The Haunted: Hells Reach Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to The Haunted: Hells Reach have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

  • Players can now join an in-progress game on listen servers
  • Client side achievements is now registered correctly
  • Health and enemy balance changes
  • Ammo drop wait time decreased
  • Server browser timeout decreased

notes.title: New Release - The Haunted: Hells Reach
notes.notes:
Winner of 2010′s Make Something Unreal contest, The Haunted: Hells Reach is Now Available on Steam!

All Hell Has Broken Loose!!! The Haunted is a fast paced third person action horror game that focuses on delivering an intense multiplayer experience. Your goal is to liberate cursed places and survive the assault from the minions of Hell.
